req.title: Fetching completed tasks
req.statement: The system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /tasks/?completed=true (or false) must filter tasks by completion status. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 6 completed tasks (ids 1,2,3,9,15,19) and 14 incomplete tasks. Tests must: (1) verify completed=true returns exactly those 6 tasks with correct ids and completed=True fields; (2) verify completed=false returns exactly 14 tasks; (3) verify omitting the filter returns all 20; (4) verify an invalid value for completed yields HTTP 422; (5) verify boundary behaviour at skip/limit edges. Assertions use exact counts and exact field values to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks

import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
DB_URL = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
seed_data = [
    (1,'Read chapter 5','desc',True),(2,'Book flight tickets','desc',True),
    (3,'Submit expense report','desc',True),(4,'Prepare meeting agenda','desc',False),
    (5,'Write project report','desc',False),(6,'Run unit tests',None,False),
    (7,'Fix login bug','desc',False),(8,'Prepare meeting agenda',None,False),
    (9,'Pay electricity bill','desc',True),(10,'Organize desk',None,False),
    (11,'Water the plants','desc',False),(12,'Review pull request',None,False),
    (13,'Buy groceries','desc',False),(14,'Buy groceries',None,False),
    (15,'Renew gym membership',None,True),(16,'Fix login bug','desc',False),
    (17,'Call the bank',None,False),(18,'Reply to emails',None,False),
    (19,'Schedule dentist appointment',None,True),(20,'Reply to emails','desc',False),
]
with Session() as s:
    for row in seed_data:
        s.add(models.Task(id=row[0],title=row[1],description=row[2],completed=row[3]))
    s.commit()
def override_db():
    db = Session()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_db
client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get('/tasks/?completed=true')
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert len(body) == 6
assert all(t['completed'] is True for t in body)
assert {t['id'] for t in body} == {1, 2, 3, 9, 15, 19}
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf.name)
